# Dispatch 809 (byte copy)

The file the 809 section 7 corporate-site strings were generated from, taken 2026-11-06.
The 809 rows of `.github/signed_strings.json` were generated by programmatic extraction
from this copy (`.github/scripts/dispatch_809_strings.py --write`; no string retyped).
`dispatch_809_strings.py --check` (CI) re-derives every row from this file, asserts byte
equality, and pins the file's size and SHA-256; `signed_strings_check.py` proves each
string renders at its targets, and with `--source-root` at the desk re-extracts it from
the original.

| Copy | Source | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|

The copy is LF-only, so its house pin (sha256 after CRLF→LF, first 16) is
`c7271feef01379d7`. `.gitattributes` marks this folder `-text`, so every checkout holds
the same bytes.

The register sentence's two values (52 records, as of 2026-11-06) are not in the copy:
they come from one read of `https://api.phronesisintel.com/.well-known/scorecard.json`
(`aggregate_stats.forecast_count`, and the UTC date of `metadata.generated_at`
2026-11-06T04:14:39Z), recorded with the body's SHA-256 in the `809-register` row's
`derivation`.

Do not edit these files. A corrected source is a new copy with a new hash, and the rows
are regenerated from it.
